summary: A save over a revision that moved may be answered refused or conflict (1.22.1), with reason revision_moved and the current revision, nothing written; the component reads either as a conflict.

then.note: Either answer is right: refused (1.21.0) or conflict (1.22.1). Reason revision_moved and revision "9", the current one; nothing is written. The card keeps what the person typed, says the record moved and reads it again at revision 9. Answering applied would lose the save that moved it.
